attributes.name: Venomous Fighting Fan +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Acrobatics skill + 1d4+1; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 1d12 and the Poison trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

On your combat check, if proficient with weapons, and you played a weapon that does not have the 2-Handed trait, discard this card to add 1d6 and the Poison trait.
